Provides a prepared historical extract of OpenPowerlifting competition
results, tools for comparing a three-lift performance with similar
competitors, and an interactive Shiny application for exploring
lift-specific and total-strength percentiles.

# Package index

## Package functions

- [`compare_lifter()`](https://etc5523-2026.github.io/etc5523-assignment-4-adhi0021/reference/compare_lifter.md)
  : Compare a lifter with similar competition performances
- [`run_powerlifting_app()`](https://etc5523-2026.github.io/etc5523-assignment-4-adhi0021/reference/run_powerlifting_app.md)
  : Launch the Powerlifting Peer Benchmarker

## Dataset

- [`powerlifting`](https://etc5523-2026.github.io/etc5523-assignment-4-adhi0021/reference/powerlifting.md)
  : Historical OpenPowerlifting competition performances
